Sensei Sandy BJJ policy

30-Day Training Fit Guarantee

Starting Jiu-Jitsu requires trust. Your first Youth or Adult 12-week program term includes our 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee.

Who qualifies

The guarantee applies to each student’s first Youth or Adult 12-week program term.

What you need to do

  1. Attend at least four small-group classes during the first 30 calendar days of your program.
  2. Text Sandy within those first 30 calendar days if the program is not the right fit.
  3. Give us the opportunity to adjust your schedule, small-group class, partner matching, or starting plan.

Your refund

If you still prefer to leave, we will refund the amount paid for your first 12-week program term in full.

What is not included

The guarantee does not apply to renewed 12-week program terms, annual plans, visitor passes, vacation passes, class packs, private coaching, merchandise, or optional add-ons.

Questions about the guarantee?

Text Sandy at (917) 736-8649.
